protocols.title: Melanotan I (10 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Page research convention: 0.5–1 mg SC once daily loading until pigmentation, then 1 mg once or twice weekly maintenance. 10 mg + 2 mL gives 5 mg/mL. Afamelanotide approval applies only to clinician-placed 16 mg EPP implant, not self-injected research peptide.

schedule.description: Once daily until pigmentation builds; source describes a common research convention, not clinical guidance.
Once or twice weekly after loading; source says approved afamelanotide is a clinician-placed implant, not this self-injected material.

regimen.notes: Source convention only. FDA approval applies only to clinician-placed afamelanotide implant for EPP, not self-injected research peptide.
